```yaml
name: Labeler

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Labeler
        uses: actions/labeler@v5
        with:
          repo-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: true
```
